parsed.summary: R1 is a router that connects the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) to the link-to-r2 (10.0.12.0/30) and forwards traffic to the far-side segments (10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.99.0/24, 10.0.4.0/24). It also has an applied firewall rule that drops traffic from the client segment to the reserved network (10.0.5.0/24).
